title: Visual Token Routing: Learning to keep tokens that matter
abstract: arXiv:2611.06854v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Computer-use agents (CUAs) have recently achieved superhuman performance on several long-horizon benchmarks. However, their computational cost limits their use in long-horizon tasks and real-time domains such as video games. A key bottleneck is representing each screenshot as thousands of visual tokens, which accumulate into long contexts as agents reason over extended interaction histories. We observe that most of these visual tokens are either semantically irrelevant to the agent's next action or temporally redundant across screenshots. Building on this observation, we introduce Visual Token Routing (VTR), a joint training framework for learning sparse visual representations that preserve the information needed for action prediction. translated_title: 视觉令牌路由：学习保留重要的令牌
translated_abstract: 计算机使用智能体（CUAs）近来在多个长时程基准测试中取得了超越人类的性能表现。然而，其计算成本限制了它们在长时程任务以及视频游戏等实时领域中的应用。一个关键瓶颈在于将每张截图表示为数千个视觉令牌，而随着智能体在长期交互历史中进行推理，这些令牌会不断累积形成漫长的上下文。我们观察到，这些视觉令牌中的大多数要么在语义上与智能体的下一个动作无关，要么在时间维度上跨截图存在冗余。基于这一观察，我们提出了视觉令牌路由（VTR），这是一个用于学习稀疏视觉表示的联合训练框架，旨在保留动作预测所需的信息。在VTR中，我们将视觉语言模型与一个轻量级的时空路由器联合训练，该路由器检查当前及此前截图中的每个图像区域，并判断其视觉令牌……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了视觉令牌路由（VTR）这一联合训练框架，利用轻量级时空路由器筛选截图中真正关键的视觉令牌，在保留动作预测所需信息的同时大幅降低计算机使用智能体的计算成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Visual Token Routing (VTR), a joint training framework that uses a lightweight spatio-temporal router to keep only the visual tokens that matter for action prediction, significantly reducing the computational cost of computer-use agents.
